correctness.rationale: Each induced star of the rook graph is necessarily one row/column corner or one single edge. Different components use disjoint row and column supports; the converse holds. Counting the labeled group matching proves every coefficient. The resource identities R=t+c and C=t+b imply the exact maximum and exhaust equality cases. An independent original-definition enumeration reproduced all coefficients and no-larger-size checks for eleven boards.
